📝 Remembered: lower back hurts after deadlifts

Lower back pain after deadlifts is a sign to ease off. Cut the weight a lot or skip deadlifts until it settles, and stay pain-free in whatever you do. If the pain is sharp, spreads down a leg, or lasts more than a few days, stop and see a doctor or physio.

⚠️ Mild soreness that fades within a day or two is usually okay. Pain that gets worse or keeps coming back isn't.
